distinguishing_features: Active aerodynamic load-shedding via localized bleed or swirl injection to modulate radial blade tip force
Uses compressor discharge pressure and flow rate signals to dynamically control tip pressure profile without physical geometry change
Directly counteracts thermal and centrifugal deflection by managing aerodynamic force balance at the tip
Prevents rub initiation through real-time force modulation rather than monitoring or procedural duty-cycle changes
parsed.objective_technical_problem: How to actively prevent gas turbine blade tip rub during transient loading without altering blade or casing geometry and without adding new sensors
parsed.viable_reason: The mechanism uses feasible pressure differentials and existing signals to produce sufficient force modulation to counteract deflection, and the test protocol validates rub prevention via measurable acoustic signatures.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: The active control of aerodynamic forces at the blade tip using existing telemetry to dynamically oppose mechanical deflection is not an obvious extension of monitoring-based or procedural thermal cycling methods in the prior art.
